about: The random choices of the 3D structure (src/structure/choices.js), kept so that a change of the outlines keeps the links. u: a number in [0, 1) for each choice (a choice is made where u is less than its rate); take: the flats in two buildings and the holes, in order; chain: the buildings of the north-south route, north to south; chainLinks: its links (two buildings and a floor); seeds: the seed of the own random numbers of each building (its heights, its flats); layout: the storeys, kind, source of the storeys and name that the layout gave each building; storeys: the storeys that the roofline gave each building with no source for its storeys. Each building is the lowest code of its plots. INFERRED: all of these are random draws, not sources.
